responsibility: Android implementation of GNAT’s __gnat_sigtramp signal-trampoline hook. It adapts the platform signal/ucontext arguments to the form expected by Ada’s signal-to-exception machinery, and on ARM it routes through an assembly trampoline with explicit CFI/unwind information by extracting uc_mcontext and calling a generated common stub; on other Android targets it simply forwards to the installed handler. This file is therefore the Android-specific bridge between kernel signal delivery and unwindable Ada exception propagation.
